outfits.name: Plateau First Steps
outfits.objective: Survive the summit and the first long glide down.
outfits.merchantNote: You arrive with nothing — that is rather the point. This is the smallest kit I will pack for someone heading up before they jump.

items.reason: Mount Hylia is proper winter. Peppers first; arguments later.
Apples by the old temple — or from my crate, if you are already cold.
Something green for the pot on your first night out.

outfits.name: Kakariko First Trip
outfits.objective: Reach Kakariko before dark on a forgiving first road.
outfits.merchantNote: The trip I recommend most. Close enough to finish, interesting enough that you will want another.

items.reason: Easy food for the walk between the peaks.
Riverbank foraging is generous, but start with something already packed.
A light shield for the odd Bokoblin at a crossing — not a war, just sense.

outfits.name: Lanayru Wetland Pack
outfits.objective: Cross the marsh without learning about Lizalfos the hard way.
outfits.merchantNote: Slow country. Pack for electricity and soft ground, not for speed.

items.reason: Voltfruit for the crackle near the springs.
Electric safflina when the storm builds and metal wants a holiday.
Something simple to cook once you stop guessing at shortcuts.

outfits.name: Hateno Easy Road
outfits.objective: A gentle coastal walk to farmland and a proper village.
outfits.merchantNote: If Kakariko taught you to travel, Hateno teaches you to enjoy it. Pack light.

items.reason: Orchard country — apples travel well either direction.
Herbs for a quiet supper after the beach road.
One honest cut of meat for the cooking pot in town.

outfits.name: Lake Hylia Shore Pack
outfits.objective: Sit beside the water with a meal worth the patience.
outfits.merchantNote: Bring a reason to be still. The ruins look climbable; most of them are not.

items.reason: Shrooms from the grassy banks, or from me if the bank is stingy.
Fruit for a lakeside lunch that does not require a fight.
Salt for fish you catch — or for fish you wisely buy instead.

outfits.name: Central Cautious Pack
outfits.objective: Cross the plains without testing the old sentinels.
outfits.merchantNote: Not a first trip. Stay on worn roads, give the castle a wide margin, and do not get curious at the wrong moment.

items.reason: Defense in the pot for when the open fields feel too open.
A shield you can actually carry — not heroics, just cover.
Extra hearts for the long exposed stretches between help.

outfits.name: Woodland Fog Pack
outfits.objective: Follow the lit path into the forest without improvising.
outfits.merchantNote: The forest itself is the hazard. Pip finds my lost sense of direction endlessly funny. Follow the lights.

items.reason: Stealth helps when the fog makes every sound feel like company.
Extra stamina for the winding path that refuses to be a straight line.
Quiet food — you will be walking longer than the map admits.

outfits.name: Ridgeland Horse Pack
outfits.objective: Travel the ridge with a mount in mind and a fountain stop.
outfits.merchantNote: Open grass, wild horses, and a fairy fountain worth the walk. Patience matters more than skill.

items.reason: Swift carrots — for you, or for a horse that needs convincing.
Courser bee honey for stamina when the ridge wind picks up.
Ordinary herbs for an evening camp that is not a production.

outfits.name: Gerudo Highlands Pack
outfits.objective: Cross high, dry ground without inviting the lightning.
outfits.merchantNote: Strip metal when the sky builds. I learned that in four very loud seconds.

items.reason: Voltfruit for storms that behave like they are looking for you.
Electric safflina when voltfruit alone is not enough reassurance.
A little defense for camps you would rather walk around.

outfits.name: Faron Jungle Pack
outfits.objective: Move through warm overgrowth without buying bananas from strangers.
outfits.merchantNote: Lush, humid, and full of cover for things that like cover. Follow the river valleys.

items.reason: Mighty bananas from a seller you trust — namely me.
Stealth for jungle camps you would rather not announce yourself to.
Shock resistance never hurts this close to electric wildlife.

outfits.name: Akkala Long Road
outfits.objective: Reach the quiet edge of the kingdom without running short.
outfits.merchantNote: Help is farther away out here. Carry more than you think you need. I always do.

items.reason: Endura carrots for roads that look shorter on the map than underfoot.
Hearty insurance when the next stable is a long story away.
Apples that do not argue about shelf life.

outfits.name: Hebra Cold Pack
outfits.objective: Enter proper winter with cold resistance already sorted.
outfits.merchantNote: Do not attempt Hebra without this conversation. The cold is the main hazard, full stop.

items.reason: Spicy peppers — warm food before warm arguments.
Sunshrooms for the ridges when peppers alone feel thin.
A kite shield for snow and footing — not a full armour set, just sense.

outfits.name: Wasteland Crossing
outfits.objective: Cross heat and sand between oases without guessing at the dunes.
outfits.merchantNote: Pack for day heat and night cold. Travel marked routes. Some questions under the sand are better left unanswered.

items.reason: Hydromelon for the brutal midday stretch.
Chillshrooms when the sand is still radiating after sunset.
Voltfruit near the oasis — heat is not the only surprise out here.

outfits.name: Tabantha Wind Pack
outfits.objective: Use the frontier wind and stay warm toward the snow line.
outfits.merchantNote: Respect the wind and it will help you cover ground. I lost a hat here once. Once.

items.reason: Swift carrots for long open stretches.
Courser bee honey when the updrafts are doing half the work.
Warm safflina as you head north toward colder air.

outfits.name: Eldin Heat Pack
outfits.objective: Approach the mountain with heat resistance before you climb.
outfits.merchantNote: Fire resistance is essential near the peak — not a suggestion. Sort it before you start climbing.

items.reason: Hydromelon for volcanic approaches.
Chillshrooms when the ground reminds you what it sits on.
A flamespear if you insist on poking things that glow. Special order energy.

outfits.name: Trail Skewer Pack
outfits.objective: Cook simple skewers at any stable on any road.
outfits.merchantNote: Not tied to one region — just enough for supper when the map is still deciding.

items.reason: Hylian shrooms that behave in a pan.
Raw meat — the workhorse behind a decent skewer.
Rock salt. The difference between a skewer and a supper.
